panels_A_D.boundary_protocol: proximal Dirichlet clamp to source concentration during 0-1 s; after source removal, proximal zero-flux reflecting boundary with half-cell correction; distal zero-flux reflecting boundary with half-cell correction throughout
panels_A_D.penetration_threshold_method: 10% of overall peak; crossing linearly interpolated between adjacent spatial nodes; domain-limited cases recorded as NaN/excluded from scaling
panels_A_D.constant_mobility_control: D_const = D_relay(c_max), protocol matched to A-D clearance sweep

panels_E_F.boundary_protocol: proximal imposed flux with half-cell boundary correction; distal no-flux with half-cell boundary correction
panels_E_F.resting_cAMP_note: 5 nM baseline used for the revised Fig. 2 E-F output; change this field to 0.025 to reproduce the earlier 25 nM variant.
